note: STRUCTURE SKELETONS (rebuild-plan Phase B, layer 2). Each = a SlideStructure: a grid + ordered NAMED SLOTS that each take a primitive (primitives.json), plus a density contract (a skeleton with an empty required slot is invalid). Clustered from the ~146 whole-slide composites in block-library.json. Rendered inside SlideFrame (content region 1240x588). Built in batches per component-queue.json; each verified side-by-side vs its exemplar render (G3).

structures.name: Financial statement + numbered commentary
structures.grid: 2-col: table left ~700px | commentary right ~500px, 16px gutter, full 588 height
structures.density: 2 slots, both required; commentary chips key to table rows

structures.name: Cash flow: 3 mini-tables + chart + notes
structures.grid: 2-col: left ~430px stack of 3 mini-tables | right ~780px split chart-over-notes
structures.density: 3 stacked mini-tables + 1 quarterly stacked-bar chart + 1 labelled notes panel; all required

structures.name: Business-plan FCF: 3 multi-year tables + notes
structures.grid: 2-col: left ~720px stack of 3 multi-year tables | right ~490px labelled notes panel
structures.density: 3 stacked multi-year tables + labelled notes; no chart (vs cashflow-dashboard)

structures.name: Bridge / waterfall + drivers commentary
structures.grid: chart band ~330px top (full width) | commentary/driver panel ~230px bottom (full width)
structures.density: 1 waterfall/bridge + a driver/commentary panel; both required
